info.name: QAssure — Document Management Service
info.description:
All 17 Document Service endpoints verified against live system on 28-Feb-2026.

Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Auth: Supports THREE authentication modes:
(a) JWT only — QAssure UI users via Authorization: Bearer header
(b) JWT + API Key combined — Module on behalf of user (after SSO launch). JWT from verify-launch-token + X-API-Key. User permissions enforced. Audit trail shows real user.
(c) API Key + X-Tenant-ID — Module system/cron operations. Full module-level access. No user context.

Tenant: Pharma Corp (c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001)

Roles with access:
- Tenant Admin: document:read/write/delete (seeded)
- Super Admin: bypasses permission checks
- Custom roles: when Tenant Admin grants document permissions
- API Key only (mode c): full module-level access
- JWT + API Key (mode b): user's actual role-based permissions enforced

request.description:
Creates minor version: 0.1 → 0.2 → 0.3
Requires: document:write

IMPORTANT: Resets document status to 'draft' — must go through review again.
SHA-256 hash auto-calculated from content.

Optional: content, content_html, change_summary, change_reason, is_major_version, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type

Returns 13-field version object.

Creates major version: 0.2 → 1.0, 1.3 → 2.0
is_major_version=true increments major, resets minor to 0.

Also resets document status to 'draft'.

Grants 24-hour exclusive lock.
Requires: document:write

Success: { checked_out: true, expires_at: '+24h' }
Same user re-checkout: { already_checked_out: true, by_current_user: true }
Different user: Error 'Document is already checked out by another user'

Logs 'checkout' in document_access_log.
Checkout NOT visible in GET /documents/:id response.

Releases exclusive lock. Only the checkout user can checkin.
Requires: document:write

Success: { checked_in: true }
Wrong user: Error 'Document is not checked out by you'

Logs 'checkin' in document_access_log.

item.name: 🔄 Lifecycle Workflow

request.description:
draft → in_review
Requires: document:write

Validation: Only draft documents can be submitted.
Error: 'Only draft documents can be submitted for review'

Creates workflow instance via workflowEngine.startWorkflow(workflowCode='document_approval').
Stores workflow_instance_id on document.
Also updates current version status to 'in_review'.

in_review → approved
Requires: document:write

Validation: Only in_review documents can be approved.
Error: 'Only documents in review can be approved'

Optional: comments in body.
Updates version status to 'approved'.
Inserts workflow_history (action='approve', comments) if workflow_instance_id exists.

in_review OR approved → draft
Requires: document:write

⚠️ MANDATORY: reason field required.
Error if missing: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'reason is required when rejecting a document' }

Updates version status to 'draft'.
Inserts workflow_history (action='reject', comments=reason) if workflow_instance_id exists.

Validation test — empty body.
Expected: { success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'reason is required when rejecting a document' } }

approved → effective
Requires: document:write

⚠️ MANDATORY: effective_date in body.
Optional: signature_id (UUID for e-signature)

Validation: Only approved documents can be made effective.
Error: 'Only approved documents can be made effective'

Auto-calculates next_review_date = effective_date + category.review_frequency_months (if category linked).
If no category: next_review_date = null.

Also updates version: status='approved', approved_by, approved_at, signature_id.
⚠️ Does NOT insert workflow_history.

effective → obsolete
Requires: document:write

⚠️ MANDATORY: reason field required.
Error if missing: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'reason is required when making a document obsolete' }

Sets obsolete_date=NOW().
Inserts workflow_history (action='obsolete', comments=reason) if workflow_instance_id exists.

Validation test — empty body.
Expected: { success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'reason is required when making a document obsolete' } }

item.description:
Full lifecycle: draft → in_review → approved → effective → obsolete
All lifecycle endpoints return full 19-field document object.

Run in order: Submit → Approve → Make Effective → Obsolete
Or: Submit → Reject (returns to draft) → Re-submit → Approve → Make Effective → Obsolete

item.name: 🔗 SSO Launch + Combined Auth (JWT + API Key)
Step 1 — Login (get user JWT for launch)

request.description:
Login as tenant user. This simulates the QAssure UI login before module launch.
Token auto-saved to jwt_token variable.

Launch COC module for current user. Returns launch_url with token parameter.
Uses coc_module_id variable (not hardcoded).

The launch_token is a one-time token that the module backend exchanges for a session JWT.

item.name: Step 3 — Verify Launch Token (get module session JWT)

request.description:
Module backend exchanges launch token for session JWT.
⚠️ Uses coc_api_key (NOT api_key) — must match the module that was launched.

Response includes:
- user: id, email, first_name, last_name, mobile, department_id/name/code, designation_id/name/code, user_category_id/name
- tenant: id, name, slug, company_name, company_logo
- access: is_super_admin, is_tenant_admin
- permissions: array of permission strings
- module: id, module_id, name
- token: JWT for subsequent platform calls (24h expiry)
- expires_in: 86400
- expires_at: ISO timestamp

request.description:
Create new version via combined auth.
created_by = real user. Status resets to draft.
Expected: version_number 0.2

Checkin via combined auth. Only the checkout user can checkin.
Expected: { checked_in: true }
Get version history via combined auth. All versions show created_by = real user email.

Submit for review via combined auth.
Workflow started with real user identity.
Expected: status=in_review, workflow_instance_id populated.

Approve via combined auth.
✅ workflow_history.performed_by = real user UUID
✅ Audit trail shows actual user, not module.
Expected: status=approved

Reject via combined auth.
⚠️ MANDATORY: reason field required — returns VALIDATION_ERROR if missing.
Returns document to draft. Can be re-submitted.
Expected: status=draft

NOTE: Document must be in_review or approved status to reject. If running in sequence after Approve, this will work. If document was already made effective, this will fail.

Make effective via combined auth.
⚠️ MANDATORY: effective_date in body.
next_review_date auto-calculated if category linked (SOP = +12 months).
Expected: status=effective

NOTE: Document must be in approved status. If you ran Reject before this, re-submit and re-approve first.

Obsolete via combined auth.
⚠️ MANDATORY: reason field required.
Expected: status=obsolete

NOTE: Document must be in effective status.

item.name: Combined — Verify Final State + Audit Trail

request.description:
Verify final state after combined-mode lifecycle.

To verify audit trail in PostgreSQL:
SELECT wh.action, u.email as performer, wh.comments, wh.performed_at
FROM workflow_history wh
JOIN users u ON u.id = wh.performed_by
ORDER BY wh.performed_at DESC LIMIT 10;

✅ All entries should show tenantadmin@pharmacorp.com (real user), NOT module identity.

item.description:
Complete SSO launch flow and combined auth tests for module developers (LTTS).

Flow: Login → Launch Module → Verify Launch Token (gets JWT) → Use JWT + API Key for all platform calls.

This is the RECOMMENDED mode for all user-context operations.
✅ Audit trail records real user identity
✅ User permissions enforced
✅ Module identity tracked for source attribution
⚠️ Uses coc_api_key variable (NOT api_key)
⚠️ X-Tenant-ID is NOT needed — tenant derived from JWT

Run Steps 1-3 first to set up module_jwt, then run Combined requests in any order.
For full lifecycle in sequence: Create → Checkout → Version → Checkin → Submit → Approve → Make Effective → Obsolete
